name: Store P&L & Operating Costs core scenarios
description: Real Store P&L & Operating Costs Q&A pairs grounded in store P&L performance, operating cost category variances, labor and rent cost comparisons, and retail industry operating margin benchmarks: store EBITDA by region, OpEx variance by category, store labor/rent cost comparison, and retail store P&L benchmarks.

parts.text: What is our total store EBITDA performance by region for the past quarter?
West region stores achieved the highest average EBITDA margin at 16.5%, followed by Midwest at 14.2% and East at 13.8%, based on internal store monthly P&L data.
What are the main operating expense variances by category compared to budget for last month?
Store Labor had an over-budget variance of +6.2% ($28.5K) due to overtime, while Rent was on budget at 0.0% variance and Utilities saw a -3.1% under-budget variance.
How do labor and rent costs compare across our retail stores on a square foot and net sales basis?

Downtown Flagship (STORE-001) has a labor cost ratio of 16.8% of net sales and rent at $0.85/sq ft, while Suburban Plaza (STORE-002) labor is 15.2% of net sales with rent at $0.85/sq ft, based on store monthly P&L records.
How do our store EBITDA margins and operating cost ratios compare to retail industry P&L benchmarks?

Our store EBITDA margin average of 14.8% aligns well with retail industry P&L benchmarks of 13.0%-15.5%, while labor cost at 16.5% of net sales remains slightly below industry average operating expense ratios.
